name: Boiled Yuca / Cassava Root (Fibrous Spine Removed, Mashed)
whyItWorks: Peeled fresh yuca boiled until translucent and tender, with the woody internal center cord strictly removed before mashing. Gluten-free, gentle root starch.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel thick bark-like skin, cut into 2-inch chunks, and boil 25 minutes. Split each piece to pull out the hard woody center cord, then mash smooth with broth.
